items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025

ctx.x: Well it begs the question, what made you switch to the most important instrument in any combo?

Couple things. For one I had a companion, a growing-up buddy, Juni Booth, which you probably know about, Mr. Booth. He lived a couple of blocks away from me. And we were both playing piano, you know. I was taking formal lessons at the Wurlitzer School of Music, and he was kind of self-taught, also studying with one of Buffalo’s local heroes, legends, Billy Gault, pianist. I don’t know if you know about Billy Gault, but he recorded with Jackie McLean and was on the staff there at the school in Hartford for a…
